meta.title: NeMo Relay
meta.description: Runs NVIDIA NeMo Relay inside DeepSeek Harness: model and tool calls execute through Relay's managed middleware with editable guardrail rules and secret redaction, Relay's exporters record ATIF trajectories and can send OpenTelemetry and OpenInference traces (including to a local Arize Phoenix), and a NeMo Relay conversation view shows each session's trace.
